question: In Mendel’s cross, a pure tall plant (TT) is crossed with a dwarf plant (t t). The Phenotypic ratio in F2 generation is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**3:1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gregor John Mendel** did experiments on **pea grains** to find out what the **laws of genetics** are.
 
• **Mendel** used a symbol to describe the factors involved in the inheritance of characteristics.
 
• He chose **seven pairs** of properties of peas, each of which had the ability to suppress another property during the experiment.
 
• For example, **"T" for tallness** and **"t" for dwarfism** are represented as capital letters in English letters.
 
• The crossing of two plants based on a single trait is called a **monohybrid cross**.
 
• Mendel chose two of these subspecies of pea plants, one tall and the other short because they had opposite traits.
 
• When they were crossed, all of the plants that grew from the seeds in the** first generation** were **tall**. All of these **F1** plants are the first generation of plants. 
 
• Then, he **self-pollinated** the plants obtained from the **F1** generation and discovered that the ratio of tall to short plants in the **F2 generation** was **3:1**. This ratio is also known as a **hybrid ratio**.
 
• Therefore, the **Phenotypic ratio is - 3 :1 (3 tall and 1 dwarf)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Genetics** is the branch of biology that studies **heredity and variation**.
 
• With his scientific discoveries, Gregor John Mendel created the foundation for **modern genetics**.
 
• As a result, he is also known as the **Father of Genetics**.
